title: Why Teslas Are Bad At Towing (Today)
summary: Engineering Explained uses physics to show why today's electric cars, including Teslas, are poor at towing, pointing to battery energy density and weight. It examines Cybertruck and F-150 towing claims.
why: HN points to it as a solid analysis of EV towing range in truck and highway threads.

quote.text: Engineering Explained did a good video on EV towing
